summary: Virtuix Holdings Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on June 2, 2026, under Rule 424(b)(5) related to the resale registration of 34,213,618 shares of Class A common stock held by stockholders in connection with a direct listing on Nasdaq. The supplement discloses amendments to warrants held by Streeterville Capital, LLC, reducing the exercise price from $6.00 to $4.00 per share and extending the reduced exercise price period to July 27, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown and warrant amendment, not a special situation.
